verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a Plugins system with a marketplace and a 'Load unpacked plugin' developer workflow, and points to a dedicated plugin API documentation site (plugins-doc.logseq.com) that is explicitly community-driven rather than official first-party SDK docs. There's no evidence of sample projects, API reference completeness, or first-party developer guides beyond this community site, and probes show no llms.txt/openapi spec available. Missing for 10: official first-party SDK reference, code samples/starter templates, and independent corroboration that the docs are sufficient for real plugin development.
